Team — thanks for the panel today. Below is my consolidated debrief + next steps. Please add any quick bullet edits (I will submit to Recruiting after 24h).

Interview summary (90m): system design + inference deep-dive + behavior. Notes per interviewer (short):
 - Marissa: Product/roadmap fit — Alex showed strong roadmap judgment, can own a 1–2 quarter feature (green). Follow-up: wants a short take-home to validate orchestration edge cases.
 - Markus: Optimizations — demonstrated solid kernel awareness, good examples (reduced p99 by ~30% with batching config + cache warm strategies). Slight gap on quantization pitfalls (needs concrete edge-case recovery plan). Score: 4/5.
 - Grace: Leveling/calibration — strong across anchors, borderline staff vs senior (leans senior). Wants to hear concrete evidence of cross-team influence.
 - Sean (me): Systems & deployment — likes tradeoff framing; concerned about ownership breadth for large infra projects.

Consensus: move to optional 2-hour take-home focused on orchestration/edge recovery. If Alex completes and shows the expected ownership-level framing, proceed to offer.

Action items:
 - Emma / Recruiting: send optional take-home link & deadline (1 week).
 - Grace: add a short calibration note after you review the take-home (1–2 bullets)
 - Markus: please add any scoring comments in the Debrief_Template-compact.xlsx by EOD tomorrow.
 - Marissa / Sean: final decision after take-home review (we aim to close by 1/29).

Attachments referenced: Debrief_Template-compact.xlsx (scoring sheet, compact), Interview_Slate_Senior-Serving-Eng.docx (prebrief prompts)

Recommendation (current): proceed -> optional take-home -> hire contingent on take-home demonstrating ownership-level answers.
